Every report file holds one [RepoActivity](#repoactivity) object. Fields marked as optional are left out of the file when they are empty.

## RepoActivity

| Field | Type | Optional |
| ----- | ---- | -------- |
| `repo` | string | no |
| `repo_url` | string | no |
| `owner` | string | no |
| `name` | string | no |
| `start` | timestamp (RFC 3339) | no |
| `end` | timestamp (RFC 3339) | no |
| `generated_at` | timestamp (RFC 3339) | no |
| `prs_authored` | array of [PullRequestActivity](#pullrequestactivity) | yes |
| `prs_reviewed` | array of [PullRequestReviewActivity](#pullrequestreviewactivity) | yes |
| `issues_created` | array of [IssueActivity](#issueactivity) | yes |
| `issues_commented` | array of [IssueActivity](#issueactivity) | yes |
| `mentions` | array of [MentionActivity](#mentionactivity) | yes |
| `maintainer_new_issues` | array of [IssueActivity](#issueactivity) | yes |
| `releases` | array of [ReleaseActivity](#releaseactivity) | yes |
| `tags` | array of [TagActivity](#tagactivity) | yes |
